paras: Lacertaspis chriswildi, also known commonly as Chris Wild's snake-eyed skink, Chris-Wild's snake-eyed skink, and Chris-Wild's lidless skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Cameroon.
The specific name, chriswildi, is in honor of herpetologist Christopher Wild, who collected the holotype.
The preferred natural habitat of L. chriswildi is forest, at altitudes of 1,000–2,800 m (3,300–9,200 ft).
The mode of reproduction of L. chriswildi is unknown.
